plan.notes: Source: official TJC 2025-2026 Catalog with Addendum (catoid=15), Program: General Studies, AA (poid=2813). Major Courses: 16 credits (select any number of academic transfer (ACGM) elective hours needed to bring the total to no fewer than 60); TJC Core Curriculum: 44 credits; Total Semester Hours: 60. 'OR' options modeled per course choice_note (first-listed option used). The catalog prints 'xxxx' placeholders for core-curriculum and elective slots; these are modeled as choice slots, never as real courses. The five 'xxxx x3xx - Major Elective' (3 cr) slots plus the 1-cr 'xxxx x1xx - Elective' make up the 16 major-course credits. Prerequisites are not listed on the program page; see the catalog course descriptions. TCCNS codes included for Texas transfer reference.
